visual_contract.scene_model: The whole oval shows exactly one current time-of-day scene. Four persistent theme markers remain visible; the active stop replaces its marker with a theme-specific solid celestial subject.
prohibited_regressions: four time-of-day thumbnails shown side by side in one track
the same visual region or atlas cell duplicated and clipped into multiple semantic layers; mechanically packing distinct Image2-generated cells into a delivery atlas is permitted
keyframe animations on the rapidly-triggered wallpaper toggle
CSS, Canvas, SVG path, or code geometry used to draw the celestial, cloud, star, or planet artwork

generation_sources.prompt_summary: Four-row production concept for a four-stop website wallpaper switch. Each row presents one complete oval sky theme across the whole track, four persistent stops, one active theme-specific celestial subject, and a polished Windows XP pixel-art and Y2K glass finish. The concept intentionally rejects a four-thumbnail strip.

Image-generation edit of the approved concept into four separate full-width morning, day, dusk, and night oval backgrounds. All stop markers and celestial controls were removed while each row kept one coherent sky scene, a champagne pixel-glass rim, and a flat green exterior for keying.

Five standalone pixel-glass control sprites on flat green: one small pearl study plus a partly risen morning sun, a full daytime sun, an initial low setting dusk study, and a crescent moon. Morning, day, and night remain the production crops from this atlas; the pearl study is not published and the undersized dusk study was replaced by the dedicated Image2 correction below.

Dedicated Image2 correction of the dusk node: a centered full-size champagne pixel-glass badge with a low half-submerged setting sun, magenta-coral sky, and water reflection on a flat green exterior. The prompt explicitly removed the prior stray cyan line and matched the visible weight of the other three active nodes.
Standalone thin champagne, ivory, and pixel-chrome oval frame matching the approved switch, with both the exterior and interior on flat green so the production overlay can be keyed cleanly.

Four quiet but tangible inactive markers for morning, day, dusk, and night. Each is a small solid pixel-glass miniature with a theme-colored horizon and restrained champagne rim, readable as a persistent stop without looking like a generic transparent ring.

Three separate morning atmosphere bands on flat green: distant slim peach-white cloud streaks, fuller sunrise clouds, and warm dawn rays with glints. The layers are composed independently for far, mid, and accent transition roles.

Three separate daytime atmosphere bands on flat green: distant thin white-blue clouds, substantial bright cumulus clouds, and cool blue-white glints. The cloud forms are richer than the previous minimal effect and remain independent far, mid, and accent layers.

Three separate dusk atmosphere bands on flat green: long coral cloud ribbons, fuller pink-orange sunset clouds, and low golden horizon shimmers with glints, assigned to far, mid, and accent transition roles.

Three separate night atmosphere bands on flat green: a sparse small-star field, a brighter blue and lavender star field, and a ringed lavender planet with varied surrounding stars. The richer layers avoid repeating one clipped effect image.

steps: Copied the original Image2/imagegen outputs into the ignored output/imagegen/wallpaper-switch-r3 working directory without changing their visual content.
Removed the flat green exterior with the installed imagegen scripts/remove_chroma_key.py helper using border auto-key, soft matte, transparency thresholds, and despill.
Split each generated atlas into its documented equal cells, cropped each cell to its alpha bounding box, and added transparent padding where the target aspect ratio required it.

Resized the keyed crops with Lanczos resampling to the declared production dimensions and saved optimized PNG files; transparent overlays retain RGBA while the four complete scene crops are intentionally opaque RGB.

After the 25 distinct content files were byte-locked, mechanically stacked the 24 non-frame files at their native cell dimensions into seven vertical delivery atlases in the declared order. Transparent source pixels are copied as straight RGBA so partially transparent artwork remains visually equivalent; no cell is resampled, repeated, blended with another cell, or repurposed for another semantic layer. frame.png remains a standalone delivery file.

No celestial body, cloud, star, planet, frame, marker, ray, or scene artwork was drawn or synthesized in code. Code was used only for the mechanical copy, chroma removal, equal-cell crop, alpha-bounds crop, transparent padding, resize, PNG optimization, and distinct-cell vertical atlas packaging steps.

delivery_contract.packaging_rule: Every atlas cell is a different byte-locked Image2-generated content asset. Runtime cropping may select a declared distinct cell; it must never duplicate one cell or visual region to stand in for another theme, depth, marker, or celestial.
